question: How to Install a Pressure Transmitter for Gas, Liquid and Steam?
body_html:
Pressure transmitter installation depends on the fluid, because the transmitter position and impulse line slope decide whether condensate or air gets trapped.

ServiceTransmitter positionImpulse line
GasAbove the tap, tap on top of pipeSlopes down to the tap, at least 1:10
LiquidBelow the tapSlopes up to the tap so bubbles rise out
SteamBelow the tapCondensate pot protects the sensor

Wrong routing can cause errors of 0.5 to 2%.
